description: Change an open perp order on HyperLiquid: move a TP/SL trigger (triggerPrice), re-price a resting limit (price) or change its remaining size. Omitted fields keep their value; give at least one. The order is replaced, so the result carries a new orderId (retData.orderId) and the old one (previousOrderId). To remove a TP/SL use cancel_perp_order; to add a missing one use add_position_tpsl.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

coin.description: Asset symbol of the order; builder-DEX assets as 'dex:ASSET'

orderId.description: Order id (oid) of the open order

price.description: New limit price. Leave out for a TP/SL so a market trigger keeps its execution buffer

size.description: New remaining size in contracts ('0' only for a position-level TP/SL = whole position)

szDecimals.description: Market size decimals (HL meta szDecimals); checks precision instead of letting the back-end round

triggerPrice.description: New trigger price; TP/SL (trigger) orders only

name: modify_perp_order
